name: Police Rescue
description: Police Rescue was an Australian television series  The series dealt with the New South Wales Police Rescue Squad based in Sydney and their work attending to various incidents from road accidents to train crashes.

videos.title: Pilot - Rescue
videos.overview: The telemovie which launched the highly successful series about The Police Rescue Squad who are the quiet heroes of the police force. The introduction of a female member causes initial conflict and mistrust until she proves herself as capable, if not more so, than any male member.

videos.title: Police Rescue In Action
videos.overview: Producers Sandra Levy and John Edwards go behind the scenes to introduce the cast and crew to the audience. Interviews with Gary Sweet, Sonia Todd, Steve Bastoni and Zoe Carides provide an insight into what it takes to be part of this team. Viewers are able to watch the stunts come together, see how the extraordinary crashes happen and witness the crew as they film the series and the feature film.

videos.title: Mates
videos.overview: A highly successful businessman who threatens suicide makes Mickey realise how lucky he really is.

videos.title: Angel After Hours
videos.overview: A police psychiatrist rides with Mickey and Angel while Angel tries to cope with the return of his alcoholic and abusive father.

videos.title: L.P.G.
videos.overview: A liquidified petroleum gasoline tanker crashes with another truck, endangering a suburb and a nearby gas factory.

videos.title: The Cosmic Lightbeam
videos.overview: After Mickey and Angel have an argument, they are trapped in a collapsed mine that served as a munitions storage dump during WWII.

videos.title: Mad Dog
videos.overview: Rescue is called in to provide security at a prison while the staff is on strike. Angel tries to help an old friend he finds incarcerated in the prison while Rescue later participates in the search for an escaped prisoner.

videos.title: Saturday Night
videos.overview: Rescue holds a party for Inspector Adam's birthday. Ridgy encounters difficulities when he goes fishing.

videos.title: Reunion With Snake
videos.overview: Sootie and Angel work to free a man trapped under a house by a gas explosion. The rescue is complicated by the presence of a potentially poisonous snake.

videos.title: Raid
videos.overview: In an attempt to gather evidence against a money launderer, SOG asks Rescue to lead the penetration against his secure estate.

videos.title: One for Dad
videos.overview: Rescue participates in the search for a child lost in the wilderness. Working on her rescue, Frog and Mickey spend the night in a swamp.

videos.title: Hostage
videos.overview: Bank robber hold two women hostage in a house; outside, Mickey and Georgia struggle to free a pregnant woman in labor from a car.

videos.title: Up a Tree
videos.overview: A young environmentalist holds a sit-in on a treetop to protest the building of a high-speed road through the wilderness and Mickey balks when politicians try to use Rescue to evict her. Georgia and Mickey rescue a puppy. Mickey attempts to strengthen his bond with his son, Sam.

videos.title: Saving the Princess
videos.overview: A worker and two runaways in demolished building; meanwhile, an injured man is trapped in theatre scaffolding while a play continues beneath him. Sootie is attracted to the new cleaning lady.

videos.title: By the Book
videos.overview: Mickey temporarily runs the squad. Georgia is put on restricted duties at the station after she decides to give priority to the rescue of a criminal trapped in a wrecked police car.

videos.title: The Right Stuff
videos.overview: A police officer-cum-football star transfers into Rescue. The retired Inspector who helped create the Rescue squad is helping write a history of the service, which creates political difficulties for Adams.

videos.title: Off the Track
videos.overview: The squad responds to a train crash. Mickey works in the compartment where a critically injured man hides his injuries to encourage the other passengers.

videos.title: The Hard Way
videos.overview: Georgia becomes increasingly suspicious of the circumstances surrounding an apparently straightforward car crash. A homeowner finds a runaway camping on public land and tries to have Rescue run him off.

videos.title: The Big Canary
videos.overview: Mickey is assigned to protect a whistleblower prior to her testimony in a court case.

videos.title: Judgement Day
videos.overview: Frog must appear before a coronial inquest after he disregards proper procedure to lead the team into an unstable partially collapsed building in an attempt to rescue a trapped child. The effort nearly costs Georgia her life and the child ultimately dies in hospital, initiating a fierce debate amongst the squad. Frog and Kathy respond to a home where a man has murdered his wife and three children. Finding the husband with a gun in his hands, Frog passively stands by waiting for him to finish the job by taking his own life. Frog descends into a ravine to rescue an injured boy.

videos.title: Stakeout
videos.overview: The squad welcomes a new member, Constable Brian Morley. With the of Sydney excited over the Grand Final football match, Mickey, Georgia, and Brian attend an MVA which is complicated by unknown hazardous chemicals, a Drug Squad surveillance operation, and a man trapped in a truck who cheerfully refuses to be rescued. Angel and Kathy respond to the scene of a party where a drunken reveller has fallen into an abandoned underground shelter.

videos.title: Sugar
videos.overview: Kathy refuses to deal with her emotions when tragedy strikes her family. After Mickey scales an apartment building to rescue a woman locked out on her balcony, he, Georgia and Kathy attend the scene of a fatal car accident caused by a drunk driver. Angel has to deal with his brother Con, who is getting into increasing trouble. Kathy descends in to a silo to rescue a worker buried up to his chest in sugar.

videos.title: With a Vengeance
videos.overview: After two youths crash a stolen plane in the National Park requiring rescue, Mickey finds himself being sued for negligence by the owner of the plane — the father of one of the kids. With a legal battle looming, Mickey receives help from the one man he would least expect it from.

videos.title: Reasons to Live
videos.overview: The squad is called on to save an artist who is obsessed with his wife's "affairs" and who has decided to kill both himself and his family. Mickey agrees to be Angel's best man but their close relationship becomes an obstacle for Angel in his relationship with Helena. A groom learns the benefits of a ball and chain while suspended from a bridge.

videos.title: From This Day Forward
videos.overview: Nipper voices his doubts that Brian will ever become an intergrated member of the squad. He also has to deal with harrassment from a recently released criminal he arrested years ago who bears a grudge. Angel and Helena tie the knot.

videos.title: Angel's Devils
videos.overview: Angel becomes convinced that Helena is having an affair and begins losing control, both at home and at work. Inspector Adams finds a pamphlet on unplanned pregnancy as well as a pregnancy test in Sharyn's desk. Teenage lovers threaten to jump off the Harbour Bridge. Georgia and David discuss having children.

videos.title: The Real Meaning
videos.overview: Mickey and ambulance officer Tricia Mellick receive public accolades and media attention after being involved in a high profile rescue. Georgia questions her future with the police after she has a close call on a rescue. Mickey finally admits to himself his feelings about Georgia just as she decides to make a commitment to David.

videos.title: Heartbeat
videos.overview: Tensions between Mickey and Georgia build as her marriage to David draws near. Mickey and Angel rescue a superhero from a tight situation. The squad is called out to help rescuea group of archeologists who have been trapped in a flooding cave system. During the search, Mickey is swept away in the rising flood waters.

videos.title: Lifeline
videos.overview: When Inspectors Adams answers a telephone call from a little girl, it turns out to be much more than he bargained for.

videos.title: Wild Goose Chase
videos.overview: A hysterical woman insists that her husband is lost and injured in the woods. When the police learn that he had been threatening to leave her, they call off the search.

videos.title: On a Roll
videos.overview: Angel and Mickey protect a bookie. Angel discovers the temptation of easy money when he gets some tips on picking winning racehorses.

videos.title: Prodigal Daughter
videos.overview: Newly promoted Georgia is seconded to a policy task force; among the items on their agenda: the end of the Rescue Squad.

videos.title: The Loaded Boy
videos.overview: During a rescue, Angel and Kathy are accidently contaminated with radiation poisoning. While they deal with the after-effects, the squad searches for a radioactive tin picked up by a small boy.

videos.title: Good Buddy
videos.overview: Brian is duped by an old friend of Nipper's.

videos.title: Rush Hour
videos.overview: A senile woman and then two children become lost in train tunnels during rush hour; stopped commuters trapped in the trains are subject to panic.

videos.title: Speeding
videos.overview: Mickey is concerned when three friends of Luke's die of drug-related problems. Angel gives Mickey advice on raising children.

videos.title: Lift Sixteen
videos.overview: After an earthquake, Nipper is trapped in a lift with four other people. The rescue is complicated when the counterweight breaks free and endangers the lift.

videos.title: Whirlwind
videos.overview: Kathy is swept up by a hang-glider pilot who turns out to live life too close to the edge. Brian confesses his crush to Kathy.

videos.title: Cold Snap
videos.overview: Feeling under-appreciated, Angel decides to leave Rescue. Mickey rescues some people from a stuck ferris wheel. Mickey and Georgia are called to rescue a pair of climbers from a cliff.

videos.title: Double Illusion
videos.overview: Angel and Mickey rescue a man being chased by two police officers. When the man turns up dead 43 minutes later, they suspect the cops.

videos.title: The Last to Know
videos.overview: Mickey father suffers a heart attack. Mickey negotiates with bank robbers to free hostages during a bank robbery.

videos.title: On the Outer
videos.overview: Brian bonds with a traumatised woman after they are both trapped in a collapsed parking structure. There's conflict at the base when Brian decides he can no longer take the morbid on the job humour of Angel and Mickey and considers his future in Rescue.

videos.title: Conduct Endangering Life
videos.overview:
Nipper find's his Police shirt somewhat pink because his daughter put her red top in the wash at the last minute. Nipper walks around work with his jumper on despite the warm weather.

Later on that day Rescue gets a call about a siege at a bank in Chatswood, one cop dead and at least ten hostages. The gunman is desperate for drugs. A young unexperienced journalist crosses the press line and begins snooping around.

Nipper's three daughters ring him at work, as mum hasn't picked them up from ballet. The kid's end up at the rescue head quarters.

Mickey is given the task of taking the gunman in some methadone, the hostage there to collect in Nippers wife Michelle. When Nipper is told he heads straight to the scene but doesn't tell the children.

It is revealed that the gunman has a TV inside the bank as the young reporter reveals in a special bulletin against a news blackout that a Police Rescue officer's wife is one of the hostages after he overheard a conversation by Rescue squad members.

videos.title: Wrong Side of the Road
videos.overview: Mickey and Nipper help the survivors of a bus crash. Mickey is determined to prove the bus driver is not at fault and Nipper decides to foster a boy orphaned in the crash.

videos.title: Something's Got to Give
videos.overview: In search of a change, Georgia applies for Nipper's job. To Georgia's surprise she doesn't get it. Instead someone from head office gets the job. Sergeant Webb arrives in Rescue and quickly lays down the law with a series of new rules and procedures. As he sstruggles to earn the respect of the squad, Webb must deal with personal demons and professional problems. Angel shows signs of stress, both on and off the job. A series of high platform rescues change the squad and offers Webb a change at redemption.

videos.title: Guardian Angel
videos.overview: After a young boy helps Angel in the rescue of a mechanic at closed Luna Park, he befriends Angel and tries to fix Angel up with his mother. Brian is concerned about an elderly man who is apparently seeking attention with a series of apparant nuisance calls. Mickey tries to help Angel sort out his life after his breakup with Helena.

videos.title: Double Jeopardy
videos.overview: A natural gas explosion leaves three people trapped two stories under ground. The squad tries to provide rescue but with time running out, a second gas explosion traps them as well. With a rapidly diminishing air supply and cyanide gas leaking into the cellar, Mickey, unwilling to abandon the trapped workers, disobeys an order from Inspector Adams to leave the scene.

videos.title: Crossing the Line
videos.overview: After the rooftop rescue of a child left alone by a single mother, Georgia decides to give the drug addicted woman a second chance and doesn't report the violation to community services. When the mother disappears and is later picked up for theft, the children hide out in a train yard. A driver sues Angel for the damage incurred to his car during a rescue.

videos.title: Damage Control
videos.overview: Kathy comforts a dying man. After he is given tranquilizers to deal with his pain, he mistakes Kathy for his wife and she must then pass on his last messages to his wife. Georgia revives a drowned swimmer who remains in a coma. Kathy comes to the aid of a pregnant woman trapped in an elevator.

videos.title: Public Mischief
videos.overview: Called to prevent two suicides, the squad helps arrest a woman and her brother who are BASE jumpers. Later, Mickey, who is intrigued by the pair, tries skydiving with them. A man asks Georgia for a copy of her accident report about an incident at an unsafe factory.

videos.title: Breaking Strain
videos.overview: Angel tries to help his friend, a towie, who is suspected of taking money from a bookmaker after he's involved in an accident. Angel rescues a young girl after a fall at an oil depot.

videos.title: The Sharp End
videos.overview: There's an explosion in a building that's being prepared for demolishing. When Rescue arrives, one of the workers is already dead and the other two are trapped and badly wounded.

videos.title: Rescue Me
videos.overview: Georgia tries to help the daughter of an old friend deal with her brother's death. Angel learns more about his father after his death.

videos.title: Wild Card
videos.overview: When Mickey is forced to shoot one of two brothers involved in a violent robbery of a videostore, he becomes the target of the surviving brother who is looking for revenge. When his threats turn into actions and the lives of the squad are put in danger and Mickey is taken off active duty. Angel and Georgia grow closer after he asks her to be his date to a cousin's wedding.

videos.title: The Ultimate
videos.overview: Three new recruits have joined Rescue, but only two can stay, a situation that creates some tension between the three as they compete for the two open spots. Mickey faces a new set of domestic challenges when his sons move in with him.

videos.title: Nobby's Place
videos.overview: Mickey tries to get a stubborn old fisherman to stop fishing in a dangerous location; later, Mickey sees a physchiatrist after he suffers a panic attack during a rescue. At school, Tracey helps Luke stands up to the school bullies.

videos.title: The Getting of Wisdom
videos.overview: Several members of the squad, especially Angel, are having trouble with new Rescue member Joe whose risk taking and care-free attitude has placed his career in jeopardy. Inspector Adams says he will have to work on his attitude if he wants to stay part of the squad. Bill contemplates retirement after the death of a close friend. Joe's involvement with troubled rescue subject gives him his greatest challenge when she becomes suicidal.

videos.title: The River
videos.overview: A plane with a father and son crashes in the mountains. A search party is organised but the search is further complicated when Angel becomes lost as well.

videos.title: The Ship
videos.overview: There has been an explosion on a ship and several men are trapped. The job of rescuing the injured crewmen is made more difficult when the squad finds evidence of a bomb and find themselves hampered by the threat of additional explosions and a man who is not what he seems.

videos.title: Flash the Descent
videos.overview: A brother and sister are climbing a dangerous rock face. When the brother falls, the sister takes on all his weight. Georgia and a local expert climber work to rescue them. Joe and Mickey are diverted to another rescue at the site of a leadership course for corporate workers. Sharyn's coworkers help her celebrate her 21st birthday.

videos.title: The Holliman Kid
videos.overview: Not long after the Holliman family has won three million dollars in the lottery, their daughter is kidnapped and held for ransom prompting Sydney's entire police service to be mobilised to search for a kidnapped child. Georgia is faced with an important decision.

videos.title: Tomorrow Never Knows
videos.overview: After a heroic rescue from the top of Centrepoint Tower, Angel and Tracey arrive at the scene of a car accident to find his brother Con injured and his other brother Paulie dead. The driver of the other car is drunk and cops a beating from Angel. When Internal Affairs gets involved, Tracey and Angel are questioned about the incident but when the man dies in hospital, Angel is arrested and charged with manslaughter.

videos.title: The Only Constant
videos.overview:
Several members of the squad are rethinking their future. Will they stay or leave Rescue? How will it all end?

Mickey has the dirty task of rescuing a man from a chimney. Angel is given a sendoff after he is dismissed from the Police Service. The squad races an oncoming storm in their attempt to rescue two children lost in a vast system of stormwater tunnels. Georgia and Alex accept the reality of their relationship. Georgia is farwelled as she transfers out of Rescue to join a youth crime task force. Surrounded by change, Mickey reconsiders his own future at Rescue and resigns.
